newsitem.title: USA: Iowa crop progress delayed by cool temperatures.
newsitem.headline: Iowa crop progress delayed by cool temperatures.

text.p: Iowa planting progress was delayed by unseasonably cool temperatures in the week ended Sunday, although corn plantings remained well ahead of the average pace, according to Iowa's Agriculture Statistics Service.
Corn plantings were 78 percent complete, up from 53 percent last week and 58 percent for the five-year average.
Oat plantings were nearing completion with 98 percent of the crop seeded, compared with 85 percent average.
Soybeans were 12 percent planted versus nil last week and the five-year average of 15 percent, the report said.

Pasture condition improved from a week-ago was rated six percent poor, 31 percent fair, 52 percent good and eleven percent excellent as of Friday. Topsoil moisture was rated 60 percent adequate and 40 surplus.
